svg.title: Platforms and tools I work in
svg.desc: Two bar charts side by side. On the left, the business systems I read through their APIs: AroFlo, Xero, Clockify, Employment Hero, Gearbox and SharePoint. On the right, the tools I build with: Python, n8n, SQL Server, Power BI, Dagster, Excel and Obsidian. Each bar shows how much of that platform I run myself.
svg.text: How much of each platform I run myself, end to end.
